slot.subtopic: Range of a sin + b cos
slot.brief: Find the range (or max/min value) of an expression of the form a sin θ + b cos θ + c, possibly with a constraint on θ, using the amplitude bound.

stem: For real $\theta$, the maximum value of $5\sin\theta+12\cos\theta-3$ is

verdicts.working: The maximum of 5 sin θ + 12 cos θ is √(5² + 12²) = 13; subtracting 3 gives 10.

working:
$5\sin\theta+12\cos\theta\in[-\sqrt{5^2+12^2},\sqrt{5^2+12^2}]=[-13,13]$.\\
Hence the maximum is $13-3=10$.

Independent check: The maximum of 5 sin θ + 12 cos θ is √(5² + 12²) = 13; subtracting 3 gives 10.
solution:
Using $a\sin\theta+b\cos\theta\leq\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$,
$$5\sin\theta+12\cos\theta\leq\sqrt{5^2+12^2}=13.$$
Hence the maximum of $5\sin\theta+12\cos\theta-3$ is $13-3=10$.
